name: COROS
description: COROS connects Claude with COROS workout, activity, device, and training data, so users can ask natural-language questions about their performance trends. It helps users review workout records, analyze activity details, laps, segments, and FIT files, understand training load and schedules, and generate personal activity and training summaries. It is not for emergencies, clinical diagnosis, or medication advice.

_published_faq.name: How do I add COROS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add COROS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.coros.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the COROS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: COROS lists 22 MCP tools, including analyzeActivityDetail, downloadActivityFitFiles, getActivityDetail, queryActivityFitFileDownloadUrls, queryActivityLapData, queryAvgHeartRate, queryCustomActivityLapData, queryDailyHealthData, queryDevices, queryFitnessAssessmentOverview, queryHealthCheckTimeSeries, and queryMenstruationCycles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to COROS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to COROS in consumer-health on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sweat & Tonic, Vitals Vault, It's Complicated — Therapist Directory, courtsapp, and CheckCells.
COROS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
COROS is developed by COROS Wearables, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
